howto: Your turret sits at the bottom. Red drones fly in from the edges towards it.
Tap or click where you want to shoot; the barrel turns to face that spot.
Each drone that reaches the turret costs a heart.
Destroy enough drones to clear each wave. Survive 10 waves to win.
tips: Aim a little ahead of a drone: your shots take time to fly.
Drones marked with a 2 are armoured and need two hits.
Each new wave clears the sky and needs 2 more kills than the last.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right arrows turn the barrel, Space fires. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to fire at that spot. Pause button bottom left.

difficulty: Easy gives 5 hearts and slower drones; Normal 3 hearts; Hard 2 hearts and faster drones. Drones get faster every wave.

cheats.effect: Every shot fires 3 bullets in a fan

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the OVERRUN! or VICTORY! card
features.best-score-badge: KILLS and BEST at the bottom of the screen
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: OVERRUN! card with the wave reached, kills and best, or VICTORY!
